race.description: North West Real Estate & Livestock (Bm58) Hcp
race.comment: MY NAME IS (1) showed plenty of pace and figured in the placings at his first two runs this time in work. Tackled a BM82 over 1000m at Tamworth last start and found that grade beyond him. Ready to find winning form back in this far easier race. CHICKEN LEGS (5) raced on the speed and boxed on gamely to finish a close second when resuming from a spell over 1000m at Quirindi last time out. Yet to fire in a couple of previous second-up outings but this looks a very nice race for him. BUZZ SAW (3) continued his strong form this campaign with a desperately close second recently in a Class 1 over 1125m at Grafton. Goes fast so coming back to this distance holds no fears. Sure to be prominent for a long way. BRIGHELLA (11) is fitter for two runs back from a spell and can play a key role. MIDNIGHT RABBLE (14) is in fine form and has won two from two here at 950m.
